description: Demeter disaggregates projected land allocations into spatial land-use and land-cover products. The Joint Global Change Research Institute supplies the Python model and documented input schemas. Users provide observed grid-cell land areas, regional GCAM allocations, category crosswalks, transition priorities and optional spatial constraints. Grid resolution is user-defined, and the time horizon follows the input scenario years. The resulting land layers can support agricultural and water-demand studies and environmental boundary conditions for infrastructure simulations. Source access is free under the Battelle licence labelled BSD 2-Clause, which includes a naming restriction. Demeter translates GCAM outputs into inputs for more spatially detailed models. A limitation is that restrictive grid constraints can prevent the algorithm from allocating all the area expected by GCAM, so crosswalks and constraints require review. The old IMMM-SFA repository address redirects to JGCRI. No example archive was downloaded and no downscaling run was performed.
